internals: Card placement and mesh cards
Places a few axis-aligned cards on each mesh and tracks them per primitive group.
deferred
PRD-639 Decision 2026-10-21 replaces cards with texture-space tiles, because meshes carry UVs. Revisit when a mesh has no usable UV set or the judge sees UV-space error.
Card capture and physical atlas
Rasterizes albedo, normal, emissive and depth of each card into a paged physical atlas, inside a per-frame capture budget.
partial
PRD-639 Phase 2 builds a per-material atlas of base colour and emissive tiles. The GPU kernel read waits for PRD-603 Phase 2 (PRD-639 AC-2).
Surface cache residency, resolution and feedback
Picks each card's resolution from distance and from the pages that rays hit, maps and evicts atlas pages.
deferred

The ThreeNative atlas is keyed by material, not by instance, so its size follows the material count, not the scene size. PRD-639 auto-sizes tiles to the atlas. Revisit when TN_SURFACE_CACHE shows tiles shrunk below 16 texels or fallbacks for lack of atlas room.
Surface cache compression and copy
Compresses the atlas into block formats on the GPU (r.LumenScene.SurfaceCache.Compress=1).
deferred
A memory saving only. Revisit when the PRD-639 atlas bytes exceed a measured budget on the Android medium tier.
Surface cache sampling at a ray hit
Reads the cards around a hit point and blends them into the hit's albedo, emissive and lighting.
partial
PRD-639 Phase 2 reads the tile at the hit UV in the harness bake. The GPU read waits for PRD-603 Phase 2.
Scene data and primitive updates
Adds, moves and removes primitives in the Lumen scene; a move updates card transforms without recapture.
partial
Static scenes ship through GPUSceneBVH (PRD-244). A moved rigid object and the skinned-mesh guard are filed as PRD-686.
Heightfields in the scene
Represents landscape as heightfields for tracing and cards.
deferred
Terrain enters GPUSceneBVH as triangles today. Revisit when a terrain template's pack build or trace exceeds its budget (PRD-686 Phase 1 measures rebuild cost).
Shared and glue
Cvars, update task orchestration, frame temporaries, the global lighting change test and the GBuffer material read shared by the gathers.
partial
The global lighting change test is PRD-603 Phase 3. The rest is scheduling glue with no outcome of its own.

rows.parent: Screen probe gather + Short Range AO
internals: Uniform and adaptive probe placement
Places one jittered probe per 16 px tile and adds adaptive probes where the uniform corners weigh under 0.01.
open
Uniform placement is PRD-640 (prototype `probes` option on the epic). Adaptive probes are filed as PRD-684.
BRDF and lighting importance sampling
Builds a BRDF PDF from the pixels that read a probe and a lighting PDF from last frame's radiance, and refines low-PDF rays.
open
PRD-640 names it only as conditional. Filed as PRD-684 Phase 3.
Probe tracing and radiance cache handoff
Traces each probe ray on screen (HZB), then in the world, then reads the radiance cache past its coverage distance.
open
PRD-640 Phase 2. The directional cache read is PRD-685.
Probe spatial filter and irradiance conversion
Filters probe radiance with its neighbours and converts it to SH or octahedral irradiance.
open
PRD-640 Solution (3-pass filter, SH irradiance), proven by its AC-1 and AC-2.
Probe and pixel temporal accumulation
Accumulates probe radiance and the per-pixel result over frames, with depth rejection, clamp and fast update.
partial
PRD-641 Phases 2 and 3.
Integrate, tile classification and upsample
Interpolates probes per pixel with depth weights, integrates diffuse and rough specular, by tile class.
open
PRD-640 Solution (per-pixel integrate with a depth weight, composite). Rough specular above 0.4 is PRD-642 Phase 3.
Short Range AO and bent normal
Horizon search of 2 slices at full resolution with a bent normal at Epic.
open
PRD-640 Phase 3.
Hardware ray tracing paths
Hardware ray traced probe and Short Range AO rays.
deferred
PRD-645 declined at its gate; deferred until WebGPU exposes ray tracing.
Hair strands
Marks probes for hair strands and traces hair voxels.
deferred
No shipped strand hair. Revisit when PRD-671 ships strands that GI must light.
Probe debug overlay
Prints probe placement and tile classes on screen.
deferred
A placement overlay is moot until adaptive probes exist. Revisit when PRD-684 Phase 2 ships; PRD-687 holds the GI views.
Shared and glue
Cvars, parameter setup and the gather orchestration.
open
Follows PRD-640 and the PRD-644 tier table.
Light culling into card tiles
Culls lights to card tiles, at most 8 per tile at Epic.
partial
PRD-639 Phase 3: at most 8 lights per hit, brightest first, culled by range.
Card shadowing
Shadows card lighting from shadow maps first, then traces offscreen shadow rays; applies light functions and cloud transmittance.
partial
PRD-639 Phase 3 casts one BVH shadow ray per light. Light functions and cloud transmittance at the hit are not filed: ThreeNative has no light functions, and cloud shadows wait for PRD-665.
Direct lighting accumulation, update budget and combine
Accumulates light per card texel, refreshes atlas/32 texels per frame, and writes (direct + indirect) x albedo + emissive.
partial
PRD-639 evaluates light per hit; a cached page is added only if Phase 3 measures the per-hit cost above budget (PRD-639 Solution step 3).
Radiosity
Traces 4x4 hemisphere probes every 4 texels on the cards and accumulates bounces over frames.
partial
PRD-603 Phase 2 adds the bounce from the field's previous generation instead. No box makes a PRD-640 world hit add indirect light; a PRD-640 box is proposed.
Stochastic direct lighting
Samples many lights stochastically per card texel.
rule
Unreal marks it experimental, default 0, and allows it only with hardware ray tracing (LumenSceneDirectLightingStochastic.inl:3-7, :57-60).
Hardware ray traced card lighting
Hardware ray traced shadows and radiosity rays for cards.
deferred
PRD-645 declined at its gate; deferred until WebGPU exposes ray tracing.
Shared and glue
Cvars and helpers.
partial
Follows PRD-639.
Tile classification and ray generation
Classifies tiles, keeps pixels up to roughness 0.4 and generates GGX rays.
open
PRD-642 Solution and Phase 2 box (roughness 0.4 and less trace, rougher pixels cast no ray).
Reflection tracing
Traces screen, then world, samples scene colour at an on-screen hit, and runs distant screen traces.
open
PRD-642 Phase 2 (BVH continuation). Scene colour at hit and the 40 ray-intensity clamp are not named; a PRD-642 box is proposed.
Spatial resolve
Reconstructs each pixel from 5 neighbour rays in an 8 px kernel at Epic.
open
PRD-642 Solution step 3 (spatial pass).
Temporal denoiser
Accumulates up to 12 frames with neighbourhood clamp.
open
PRD-642 Solution step 3, reusing PRD-641 history code.
Bilateral filter
A depth-aware filter of 4 samples in an 8 px kernel after the temporal pass, on by default.
notfiled
PRD-642 names a spatial and a temporal pass only. A PRD-642 box is proposed instead of a PRD.
Front layer translucency and water passes
Runs Lumen reflections on the front translucent layer and on single-layer water.
deferred
Front layer is off by default (BaseScalability.ini:546, FrontLayerTranslucency.cpp:22-38). Water uses Lumen reflections whenever they run; a PRD-642 box for the sailing water surface is proposed.
Ray traced translucency
Hardware ray traced translucency with refraction.
deferred
Hardware ray tracing only; PRD-645 declined at its gate.
Hardware ray traced reflections and hit lighting
Hardware reflection rays and full material hit lighting.
deferred
PRD-645 declined at its gate; deferred until WebGPU exposes ray tracing.
Shared and glue
Cvars, composite parameters and the reflection orchestration.
open
Follows PRD-642 and the PRD-644 reflection tiers.
Probe marking, allocation and indirection
Marks probes that pixels use, allocates atlas slots from a free list and frees probes unused for 8 frames.
partial
PRD-605 Decision: wrap-addressed rings and a frustum use window instead of an indirection pool.
Update priority and trace budget
Buckets probes by age gap over clipmap index and traces 150 per frame at Epic.
open
PRD-603 Phase 3 stale queue; PRD-605 Phase 3 ring divisor.
Probe offset out of geometry
Moves a probe out of geometry using the GBuffer or the global distance field.
partial
PRD-604 marks a probe inside geometry invalid instead of moving it.
Probe tracing with BRDF-driven trace tiles
Traces each probe in tiles, supersampling where screen-probe BRDF is above 0.1 and downsampling beyond 40 m.
partial
PRD-603 Phase 2 traces 64 uniform rays per probe. BRDF-driven tiles are not filed: the 64-ray budget is the cheap start; revisit if PRD-685 Phase 3 shows probe noise.
Radiance storage, spatial filter, mips and irradiance
Stores octahedral radiance per probe, filters with neighbours, adds borders and a mip, derives irradiance.
open
Filed as PRD-685. PRD-603 stores SH irradiance only.
Probe occlusion depth
Stores cosine-weighted hit distance per direction for probe visibility.
open
PRD-604 Phase 2.
Interpolation with parallax correction
Reads 8 corner probes along a direction with parallax correction and a cone mip.
open
Filed as PRD-685 Phase 2; visibility weights from PRD-604.
Hardware ray tracing
Hardware ray traced probe updates and far field.
deferred
PRD-645 declined at its gate.
Shared and glue
Cvars, visualize marking and the update orchestration.
open
Follows PRD-603 and PRD-605.

rows.parent: Tracing core (SDF, mesh culling, HW RT common)
internals: Mesh SDF and heightfield culling
Culls mesh distance fields and heightfields into a froxel grid so each ray tests few objects.
shipped
GPUSceneBVH replaces distance fields; its tree does the culling (PRD-244). The owned engine uses the PRD-642 D2 pack.
Software ray tracing against distance fields
Sphere-traces mesh SDFs near the ray start, then the global SDF, with voxel lighting far away.
shipped
Replaced by the GPUSceneBVH first-hit query (PRD-244); PRD-603 and PRD-662 confirm no distance field is built. Rigid motion is PRD-686.
Hardware ray tracing common, materials and far field
Shared hardware ray tracing setup, hit materials and far-field tracing (r.LumenScene.FarField=0 by default).
deferred
PRD-645 declined at its gate; far field is off by default in Unreal (LumenScene.cpp:86-87).
Shared and glue
Tracing utilities, position and buffer encodings.
shipped
Covered by the shipped trace (PRD-244).
Lumen scene, reflection view and surface cache views
Traces from the camera to show the Lumen scene, the reflection view, surface cache coverage and dedicated reflection rays.
open
Filed as PRD-687. PRD-646 owns indirectDiffuse; PRD-641 names framesAccumulated and fastUpdateAmount in its Solution only.
Radiance cache, radiosity and card lighting views
Draws radiance cache and radiosity probes and card lighting updates.
open
Filed as PRD-687 Phase 3 (radiance cache probes). Radiosity and card-update views are moot: no card radiosity or card update budget is built.
Hardware ray traced visualize
Hardware ray traced versions of the scene views.
deferred
PRD-645 declined at its gate.
Reservoir sampling, temporal and spatial resampling
Keeps one reservoir per half-resolution pixel and resamples it with last frame and with neighbours.
deferred
PRD-661 opens on a gate; no Unreal quality level turns it on.
Froxel volume trace and filter
Fills a camera froxel grid from the radiance cache, cone-traces at Epic and reprojects with 0.9 history.
open
PRD-643 Phase 2 reads the radiance cache per pixel first; the froxel volume is built only if that read costs more than 0.5 ms.
Translucency radiance cache and glossy reflections on translucent surfaces
Marks probes for translucent surfaces at quarter resolution and gives them glossy reflections from that cache.
open
Diffuse: PRD-643 Phase 2. Glossy reflections: filed as PRD-685 Phase 3.
Hardware ray tracing
Hardware ray traced froxel lighting.
deferred
PRD-645 declined at its gate.
Probe gather and half-resolution interpolation
Medium tier: radiance cache probes around pixels, 6x6 irradiance, half-resolution interpolate; adaptive placement off by default.
open
PRD-603 (trace and budget), PRD-605 (clipmaps), PRD-644 (the medium tier). Adaptive placement is off in Unreal (LumenIrradianceFieldGather.cpp:128).
Visibility-weighted interpolation
Weighs 8 probes by wrap, Chebyshev visibility and validity, with a normal and view offset.
open
PRD-604 Phase 2.
Final gather method and allow checks
Chooses the final gather method per quality level and checks that Lumen may run on the view.
partial
PRD-644 tier table and GIBudget; PRD-647 calibration done.
Per-view history state
Holds each view's GI and reflection histories across frames.
open
PRD-641 (gather history) and PRD-642 (reflection history).
